applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Concentration Risk Management) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: NBFC-IDFs in the Upper Layer must apply large exposure limits applicable to NBFC-IFCs.
answer.action_quote: The large exposure limits applicable to NBFC-IFC shall also be applicable to IDF-NBFC that are subject to Upper Layer regulations

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Concentration Risk Management) Directions, 2025
